question: Should OpenClaw restore or introduce an enforced default-unit coverage threshold before adding this trusted CI lane, or should the lane be explicitly scoped as report-only telemetry?
rationale: The current command is documented as informational with no thresholds, so choosing threshold values and whether trusted-main validation should fail is a CI policy decision rather than a mechanical workflow repair.

options.title: Authorize an enforced unit-lane gate
options.body: Define the intended threshold contract in the Vitest configuration, keep this job as trusted main/manual enforcement, and require a trusted run that shows report upload and threshold failure behavior.

options.title: Ship report-only coverage telemetry
options.body: Rename and document the lane as non-enforcing coverage reporting, preserving artifacts without claiming it prevents coverage regressions.

options.title: Pause pending CI policy ownership
options.body: Close or defer the PR until the CI owners choose the coverage scope, thresholds, and capacity budget.

recommendation.title: Authorize an enforced unit-lane gate
recommendation.body: Define the intended threshold contract in the Vitest configuration, keep this job as trusted main/manual enforcement, and require a trusted run that shows report upload and threshold failure behavior.
